headings.text: Find a partner to help your business integrate Zendesk solutions.
AdelanteCX — Managed AI Support Agent for Ecommerce & Shopify
How can we help? Contact us.

body: 729 Solutions is a Premier Zendesk implementation, consulting and development partner. We specialize in setting up Zendesk to best practices, integrating with other tools and optimization. With over 6 years as a leading Zendesk partner and more than 300 successful projects, we have the skills and experience to help you make the most of Zendesk.

Get a fully managed AI support agent for your ecommerce operation — built, trained, and run inside your Zendesk by our team. Automate order tracking, returns, exchanges, and more across every channel and language. No setup fees, no dev work on your end, and no compromises on security or compliance.

We design your Zendesk to work for you. Whether you're looking to get up and running with Zendesk tools or need to optimise your current setup, advoCX will help you design the best customer experience. We combine our deep technical expertise and experience implementing Zendesk software with our catalogue of best practices to enhance your customer service operation.

Aktie Now is a CX advisor and Zendesk Premier Partner — not just an implementation shop. We combine deep technical mastery of Zendesk with predictive vision to spot where a client's CX operation is about to break before it does, and we stay accountable for the outcome until it shows up in the numbers that matter: lower cost per ticket, higher retention, more revenue from the support operation. We were the first Zendesk partner in Brazil, and today we operate across 6 countries on 4 continents. That history means we've already seen most operational bottlenecks before — in different industries, different contexts, and we know exactly where to look. Ready to turn your Zendesk investment into a measurable business result? Let's talk.

Building a digital help desk and transforming the way agents, colleagues and customers interact is both an art and a science. As a Zendesk partner, we provide bespoke solutions to enable organisations to support and maintain a single view of customers. We have delivered far greater value than simply omni-channel care. We think, create, develop, and deliver in a way that accelerates growth and transforms the way organisations interact with customers.

atlantis dx is the IT service provider with extensive experience in digitization. Founded in Hamburg in 1994, the company now implements sophisticated projects in B2B and B2C environments using agile methods.With an extensive portfolio in the areas of digital consulting, e-commerce, content management, CRM, customer service, data management, marketing automation, SEA & SEO, portals, workflow automation and user experience, atlantis dx offers innovative solutions from a single source. The experienced service provider is characterized by its extensive know-how and its ability to maintain an overview of different business areas and their interaction at all times – the central focus: the best possible digital experience.

Fundada em 2013, a BCR.CX é uma empresa de outsourcing full service, consultoria e tecnologia com foco em customer experience, que oferece serviços de outsourcing de times de vendas, atendimento, suporte e sucesso do cliente, além de consultoria especializada em CRMs de vendas e omnichannel e desenvolvimento por meio de software house interna de CX.
The most active Zendesk Italian partner. We integrate Zendesk with any application using the Apps, custom channels and Sunshine
Byteleaders is Dutch certified Premier partner of Zendesk. We provide complete implementations, upgrades and full external customer service solutions (BPO).
Cloudhuset is a one of few Zendesk Premier partner with +100 implementations in the Nordics.
cloudmotion is Nederlanse implementatiepartner en adviesbureau op gebied van customer experience. Onze consultants maken op maat gemaakt advies en implementatiediensten op gebied van klantreizen.
We design and deliver innovative, bespoke solutions for your business, creating outstanding experiences for your customers – enabled by technology and enriched by our people.

At CRM Scene, we combine our expertise in Zendesk with extensive experience in business operations, automation, AI, and fintech. Our focus is on streamlining support, enhancing customer journeys, and improving efficiency through the right tools and integrations. We prioritize solutions that make a real impact and are designed to grow alongside your business.

CX Experts is the longest serving Zendesk Master Partner in South Africa, specialising in helping top brands streamline their customer service workflows through customer experience best-practice and super charging Zendesk solutions to maximise return on investment. We offer end-to-end Zendesk services—from solution scoping, design and deployment through to health checks, regular reviews and optimisation. Our team come from a diverse customer service background and we always strive to help you to drive optimal customer outcomes by using technology to make both customer and employee experience better. We've successfully supported businesses across EMEA, the US, Africa, and beyond, and we're eager to expand our reach even further!
Ras al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

Databeys is a CRM consulting and system integration company helping businesses implement, customize, integrate, and optimize Zendesk. We specialize in seamless deployments, migrations, workflow automation, custom development, and long-term support that enables teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Demeter ICT Co., Ltd. is a provider of cloud technology services for mobile applications, eCommerce, and digital marketing. With a vision of being the leading provider of ICT cloud solutions for SMEs in the AEC, the company has focused on building a customer-centered ICT service. We help to enhance the competitiveness of Thai businesses and organizations with world-class ICT solutions and excellent service.

DEMETER ICT (**Zendesk Premier Partner**, based in Bangkok Thailand, Singapore and Shanghai China) enables the CX transformations for the business to become a success. We use the world-class Zendesk tool to help the business retain customer happiness and improve CX efficiency. We have strong experiences in implementing Zendesk solutions with new CX design for more than 140 customers in APAC. In total, we have been deploying more than 2,500 customer service agents regionwide. DEMETER ICT（Zendesk Premier Partner，总部位于泰国曼谷, 新加坡, 中国上海）让CX业务转型取得成功。我们用世界级的Zendesk工具来帮助企业保持客户满意度并提高CX效率。我们在为亚太区的140多个客户实施具有新CX设计的Zendesk解决方案方面有丰富的经验。总的来说，我们已经在区域范围内部署了2500多个客户服务代理。

エクレクトは、CXソリューションカンパニーとして、800社・1,800プロジェクトを超える豊富な支援実績による知見とノウハウを元に、CX向上およびEX向上につながるサービスをトータルで提供しています。『Zendesk』のパートナーとしては、APAC NO.1の導入実績を誇り、AWSや各種AIエンジンなどさまざまな外部システムとの連携開発をはじめ、システム設計から実装・運用まで、トータルでご支援します。

Envoy is a premier Zendesk consulting and implementation partner. We're a team of Zendesk experts with a passion for building user-first customer experiences that scale. With years of experience ranging from complex, enterprise implementations to simple optimizations, our team is skilled, knowledgeable and ready to tackle support challenges of all sizes.

At Faye, we believe that every organization can be a customer experience superstar. But we also understand that it’s difficult to achieve it all on your own. That’s why we have worked with hundreds of organizations to optimize their Zendesk platform and guide them to customer experience success.
Gravity CX can help your business delight your customers with Zendesk

Talk to us about customer success, that's our world! HappiRel is a company located in Stockholm, Sweden which operates both locally and globally. We help both small and big businesses to implement and develop Zendesk. We help you to improve your customers' experience with better communication, easier processes and routines and overall workflow.

helphouse.io is the largest Zendesk Master Partner in Europe and we help some of the biggest brands optimize their customer service workflows by implementing best practice- and custom solutions in Zendesk, that can be seen on the bottom line. As both Master Implementer and Master Solution Provider we can help you with everything within Zendesk from licenses over implementations and custom apps to optimization. Besides that, we’re making popular apps and integrations for Zendesk Marketplace and have made integrations to Instagram, Shopify, HubSpot, and Google Drive to mention a few. We have already helped companies in Europe (EMEA), Denmark, Germany, Norway, Sweden, US, Africa, etc. and we want to add even more countries and regions to the list!

Más de 950 proyectos desde 2008 y Premier Solution Partner de Zendesk. Somos Implementation Partner, Business Service Provider & App Developer: diseñamos, implementamos e integramos Zendesk —con IA, automatizaciones y todos sus canales— para que tu empresa convierta la atención al cliente en un motor de crecimiento real.
